newsitem.title: UK: London precious metals close firmer led by PGMs.
newsitem.headline: London precious metals close firmer led by PGMs.

text.p: GOLD - Ended at $342.30/$342.70, up 80 cents to close near day's high. Some option-related buying seen against OTC expiry Monday. Resistance at $342.50.
SILVER - Finished quietly at $4.72/$4.74, up a cent.
PLATINUM - Ended $5.00 up with palladium at $379.00/$380.00.
PALLADIUM - Closed up $3.55 at $159.30/$160.30. Firmer on tight supply, lack of progress on Russia-Japan exports.
